summary: Phase 2 Logger tab fully verified on mobile viewport (390x844) via Expo web preview. All 9 requested flows pass: onboarding (Yes path) persists and modal does not reappear; DateBar defaults to 'Today', prev/next navigate and a 'Today' jump button appears on non-today and resets correctly; AdaptiveBanner renders 'Recovery Phase' for cycle day 1 (lastPeriodStart=today) and 'Peak Energy Phase' for day 11 (10 days ago seed) with exact required copy; banner hides when trackingEnabled=false; ExercisePicker modal shows all 5 hardcoded exercises and selecting one updates the trigger label; Save Set is disabled (aria-disabled=true) until both weight and reps are valid; saving persists via workout-storage, clears Reps but preserves Weight, populates the history list (set-list-count='1 set'), starts the 90s rest timer at 1:30 and ticks down (observed 1:29 -> 1:27), Skip dismisses it; switching to previous date shows empty state, returning to Today still shows the saved set; trash button deletes the set and the list reverts to empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from a dependency (likely react-native-web internals or @react-native-community/datetimepicker). Not a blocker; nothing to fix in app code.
Note: SetList header literally says "Today's sets" even when viewing a non-today date. Cosmetic; the count and rows are correct, but the heading could read 'Sets' or include the date for accuracy.
seed_data_creation: Seeded fit.cycle.prefs.v1 in localStorage to verify Peak Energy (lastPeriodStart -10d) and disabled-tracking cases; cleared between runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 Logger is solid. AsyncStorage on web is backed by localStorage with raw keys (no prefix). storage util JSON.stringifies values, so cycle-storage's already-stringified payload is double-stringified on disk — seed accordingly: localStorage.setItem('fit.cycle.prefs.v1', JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(prefs))). Mobile viewport 390x844 used. Onboarding flow + IndexedDB databases() not used here; localStorage is the actual backing store.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in Phase 2 implementation.
